# Payment methods

We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay and Google Pay in all countries.
Customers in the Netherlands can pay with iDEAL. Customers in Germany and Austria can pay by SEPA direct debit or by Klarna invoice (pay within 14 days after delivery).
We do not accept cash on delivery, bank transfer in advance or cryptocurrencies.

## When is my card charged?
Card and PayPal payments are charged when the order is placed. Klarna invoice and SEPA direct debit are charged after dispatch.
If a payment fails, the order is not placed and no money is taken. A pending authorization on your card disappears automatically within 3-5 working days.

## Invoices
The invoice is attached to the order confirmation email and to the shipping confirmation. Prices include VAT.
